title: You Won't See Me
lyrics_plain:
When I call you up, your line's en-ga-ged!
I had enough, so act your age!
We have lost the time, that was so hard to find!
And I will loose my mind, if you won't see me!
You won't see me!
I don't know why you should want to hide!
But, I can't get through my hands are tied!
I won't want to stay, I don't have much to say!
But, I can't turn a-way and you won't see me!
You won't see me!
Time af-ter time you re-fuse to ev-en lis-ten!
I wo-uld-n't mind if I knew what I was miss-ing!
Though the days are few, they're fill-ed with tears!
And since I lost you, it feels like years!
Yes, it seems so long, gi-rl, since you've been gone!
And I just can't go on, if you won't see me!
You won't see me!
Time af-ter time you re-fuse to ev-en lis-ten!
I wo-uld-n't mind if I knew what I was miss-ing!
Though the days are few, they're fill-ed with tears!
And since I lost you, it feels like years!
Yes, it seems so long, gi-rl, since you've been gone!
And I just can't go on, if you won't see me!
You won't see me!
